data.title: Morgan Stanley gets approval for spot Ethereum ... | Pluang
data.description: Morgan Stanley has secured approval to list spot Ethereum (ETH) and Solana (SOL) exchange-traded funds (ETFs) on NYSE Arca, trading under the tickers MSSE and MSOL. These ETFs will stake a portion of their crypto holdings to generate additional rewards, which will mostly be distributed to investors. The approval comes as ETH and SOL prices attempt to recover from recent declines, with Ethereum testing resistance near $1,950 and Solana aiming for a $90 target. This move offers traditional investors regulated exposure to these cryptocurrencies without the need to manage wallets or private keys.
